messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — our cross-func roadmap sync tomorrow overlaps with the infra triage and the Dedicated pricing review. Can we move the product-eng sync or split the agenda? Need to settle priority for the model-parallel rollout vs pricing decision.
Mira: What's the minimal attendee set? PMs + eng leads + infra?
Devon: Eng lead here — RFC review for `kv-cache` change needs ~30m. If we split, can we put the RFC deep-dive in a separate slot (Thu)?
Sam: I can shift. Legal + finance want time for pricing too. Proposal: 45m total if we keep same day — 30m roadmap + 15m pricing; RFC deep-dive in a follow-up.
Alex: Quick availability poll — can @Mira @Devon @Sam @Priya @Leo do 4/30 10:00am PT?
Mira: Yes for 10am.
Devon: Busy at 10am. Can't make that window.
Sam: I can do 10am or later. Prefer earlier but flexible.
Priya: Tentative at 10am, blocked by a customer sync. If moved to 3pm PT that works better for me.
Alex: Ok — Devon prefers later. If we move to 3pm PT, can we still fit 30m roadmap + 15m pricing? Also need an owner for the RFC deep-dive (Thu).
Devon: 3pm PT works. I'll take RFC deep-dive on Thu and aim for a 45m slot. Please add decision-log entry for the Dedicated fallback policy — we need to capture options discussed.
Sam: I'll draft the decision options and link the doc in agenda. (google.com/some-doc)
Alex: Agenda owners if we move to 3pm PT: roadmap — Sam, pricing — Priya, RFC deep-dive — Devon (Thu). Can everyone confirm?
Mira: :thumbsup: confirmed.
Priya: Confirmed for 3pm. I'll prep the pricing slides and any compliance points.
Devon: Confirmed. I'll drop the RFC PR link and a 5-min tech pre-read in the thread.
OpsBot: calendar-bot: Meeting moved by Alex — new time 2024-11-12 15:00 PT. Attendees updated.
Alex: Thanks all — I'll update calendar + agenda doc and add a short decision-log template for Priya/Sam to fill during the call.
Sam: I'll add a 3-line summary template to the doc so we can capture outcome quickly.
Priya: cool. see you at 3pm.
